Software Engineer | Talent Community

 We Are Lennar 
 Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders and a Fortune 500® company with a growing technology organization focused on innovation, digital experiences, data, and technology that helps shape the future of homebuilding.
 Technology is central to how we operate, and we're continuing to invest in talented engineers who can help us build scalable, reliable, and impactful products and platforms for our Associates, customers, and business.

 Build Your Future in Technology at Lennar 
 We're always looking to connect with talented Software Engineers who are curious, collaborative, and excited to solve meaningful problems through technology.
 This is a proactive talent community opportunity for Software Engineers interested in exploring future opportunities with Lennar. While we may not have an immediate opening that matches your background, we'd like to get to know you and stay connected as our technology organization continues to grow.
 Whether your expertise is in front-end, back-end, full-stack, cloud, APIs, distributed systems, data, or another area of software engineering , we welcome the opportunity to learn more about your experience and career interests.

 What You Could Work On 
 Depending on your background and future opportunities within the team, you may contribute to:
 Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality software that solves meaningful business and customer problems.
 Partner with product managers, designers, UX, data, QA, architects, and other technology teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
 Design and implement APIs, integrations, services, applications, and reusable software components.
 Write clean, maintainable, testable code with a focus on simplicity, performance, scalability, and reliability.
 Participate in architecture and technical design discussions and help evaluate solutions to complex engineering challenges.
 Build automated unit, integration, functional, and performance tests where appropriate.
 Participate in code reviews and collaborative development practices that promote quality and knowledge sharing.
 Diagnose and resolve complex technical and performance issues.
 Contribute to modern development practices, CI/CD pipelines, version control, and automated deployment processes.
 Help establish and improve engineering standards, practices, and processes.
 Collaborate across teams to deliver products and capabilities from concept through production.
 Stay current with emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve how we build and deliver software.
 
 The Technologies You Could Work With 
 Our technology environment continues to evolve, and opportunities may span a variety of languages, frameworks, platforms, and architectural patterns.
 Depending on the role and team, experience with technologies such as the following may be relevant:
 JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, HTML, and CSS 
 APIs, GraphQL, backend services, and third-party integrations 
 Cloud platforms and distributed applications 
 CI/CD, Git, automated testing, and modern development tooling 
 Data platforms, analytics, and data-driven applications 
 Headless CMS, e-commerce, A/B testing, and high-traffic digital experiences 
 Security, scalability, performance, and observability 
 You don't need experience with every technology listed. We're interested in understanding the problems you've solved, the systems you've built, and the technologies you're excited to work with next.

 What We're Looking For 
 We're interested in connecting with Software Engineers across a range of experience levels and technical specialties who bring:
 Professional experience designing, developing, testing, and deploying software.
 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills and the ability to break down complex technical challenges.
 A growth mindset and willingness to learn new technologies, frameworks, and approaches.
 A strong foundation in software engineering principles, including clean code, testing, version control, and collaborative development.
 The ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.
 An interest in building software that is scalable, reliable, secure, and easy to maintain.
 A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, or a related field is preferred, or equivalent professional experience.
 
 For more senior opportunities, experience with technical leadership, architecture, mentoring, system design, and leading complex engineering initiatives may also be relevant.

 Why Join Lennar? 
 At Lennar, you'll have the opportunity to apply your engineering expertise to technology challenges within a large, complex organization while working alongside talented professionals across product, data, architecture, cybersecurity, and other technology disciplines.

 We're building a technology organization that values technical excellence, problem solving, ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning . As our technology capabilities evolve, so do the opportunities for engineers to expand their skills, take on meaningful challenges, and build a career with impact.

 Interested in What's Next?
 This is a proactive posting for our Software Engineering talent community and is not tied to a specific current opening. By expressing your interest, you'll have an opportunity to introduce yourself to our team and be considered for future Software Engineering opportunities that align with your experience, technical interests, and career goals.
 We'd love to learn more about you and stay connected as our technology organization grows.
 Physical & Office/Site Presence Requirements
 This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.
 This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the position noted. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
 Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.

#IND-TECH
 
 Life at Lennar 
 
 At Lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our Associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well-being and professional growth. Our Associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. Our 401(k) Retirement Plan, complete with a $1 for $1 Company Match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while Paid Parental Leave and an Associate Assistance Plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. To further support our Associates, we provide an Education Assistance Program and up to $30,000 in Adoption Assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. From the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous Holiday, Sick Leave, and Personal Day policies. Additionally, we offer a New Hire Referral Bonus Program, significant Home Purchase Discounts, and unique opportunities such as the Everyone’s Included Day. At Lennar, we believe in investing in our Associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. Lennar Associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by Lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. Visit Lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits. 
 
 Join the fun and follow us on social media to see what's happening at our company, and don't forget to connect with us on Lennar: Overview | LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/lennar/ > for the latest job opportunities.
 
 Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.
